_comment: LAB 'Kinematics and odometry', the session's own programming: diff.launch.py and mecanum.launch.py.
world open         30 x 20 m of floor, no obstacle
passthrough false  the keys alone drive nothing: the robot moves only on the wheel speeds a
node publishes — your inverse kinematics, or nothing at all
encoders.enabled   /<robot>/joint_states, the wheel angles your odometry integrates
debug_truth        /<robot>/truth, the exact pose your odometry is compared with
gps.gap            no GPS fix for the whole run
config/lab_odometry_demo.json is the same with the simulator's own kinematics (task 0).
